name: @stratless/runtime
description: The local embedding runtime for stratless, pre-bundled to WASM. Downloaded once by the stratless CLI after explicit consent — never installed directly, never a dependency.
//: WHY THIS PACKAGE EXISTS. Declaring transformers.js as a normal dependency made a first-time
//1: `npx stratless` download 116MB and unpack 259MB — ~90% native binaries and image codecs the
//2: engine never executes. This package is the same runtime bundled by US at build time with the
//3: dead weight stubbed out: ~1.3MB of JS + one ~9.6MB WASM binary. The CLI fetches it into
//4: ~/.stratless/runtime at `init`, after the person's yes, pinned by exact version + integrity
//5: hash in CLI code. 'Nothing arrives until you say yes' — literally, auditably true.
//6: WASM ON PURPOSE — standard over speed (decided 2026-07-27): the WASM standard computes
//7: identical bits on every machine, so fingerprints are portable and cacheable; native was
//8: faster but machine-flavored. Changing ANYTHING in this bundle changes everyone's
//9: fingerprints: every version bump here is a versioned, announced rebuild in the CLI.
//dev: Exact pins, no ranges: this package's whole job is byte-reproducible output. The bundled
//dev1: libraries are devDependencies BECAUSE they are compiled in — the published artifact has
//dev2: no dependencies at all, which check.mjs enforces.
